plan-for-retiring-the-legacy-command-lay.text: Plan for retiring the legacy command layer.
Issue 486, remainder. This page is for the commit owner, the auditor and the reviewers. The requirements are in the specification; the census and the verbatim commands are in the gate.

class-of-change.text: The change keeps behaviour: it deletes code that has no command line route, and it is shown by the unchanged help snapshots and unchanged parser corpora outside the removed switch. Hosted checks are the gate, one writer, one review of the deletion list before the push.

slice.text: One slice, one pull request, in this order inside it:

Delete the roots: the fold value of the singular program and the code that runs it; the three booking values of the open-datum program, their arms in the runner and in the needed-references function; the argument records, the entry mode and the create record that only those values used; the fold switch from the shared switch list and from the tokenizer test that pins it.

Follow the compiler. Trim the export lists of the edited modules, build with the unused-binding warning on, and delete every top-level binding that only the deleted code or its tests used; repeat until the warning is silent. Typical targets are the booking, update and fold outlay helpers and the helper functions of the plan module that no command calls.

Delete the tests, corpus rows, help snapshot entries and harness legs whose subject was deleted. Re-record only the corpus rows that carried the removed switch; a row outside that set that changes is a defect.
Before deleting any test, list the production behaviour it exercised. When the same behaviour has no other test, port the test to the production command. The list goes in the pull request.
Update the code inventory, the declared checks census and the documentation that named a deleted file or value; restamp the speech companion of every edited page.

consumers-to-check.text: A change to a command flag or value touches the declared flag list, the help snapshots, the parser corpora, the application settings specification and the documented-flags check. Removed modules or flake checks need their workflow step and the declared-checks census row in the same commit. Edited pages need their speech companion restamped, and the documentation check passes under the runner's bare path.

auditor-question.text: One mute review of the census and the deletion list, asking only: does any deletion remove the only evidence for a behaviour a production command still has?
